PRESIDENT, and the U.S.A. has that, in spades!” Trump posted. “There is a SICK conspiracy going on against AI and Data Centers, and the only one that is happy about it is China,” Trump said. Vance, speaking as he prepared to fly to Kansas for a midterm election campaign event, said the Trump administration is concerned about AI but wants to make sure it is regulating the technology smartly, warning that the U.S. is in an AI arms race against China. House Speaker Mike Johnson, R-La., told reporters Monday that he expects Trump will have the AI companies potentially meet at the White House this week or next week, saying that the sit-down has yet to be scheduled.
